response.display: Try the open-A exercise in three. Count a repeating bar, sustain open A for beats 1 and 2, leave beat 3 silent, then tap beat 1 of the next bar instead of playing it. Treat that tap as where the phrase arrives. As you sustain the A, listen for whether it feels like it’s leading toward the tap, even through the silence. You can do this off the record and leave pulse and re-entry review for another day.
